transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. As you all know, we've got the comedy benefit this Saturday evening, and there's a fifteen-minute guest segment at 7:40 PM that needs to wrap before the 8:00 PM news break. Lio Hart and Mara Vale are our two finalists, with Mara Vale currently holding the larger public profile. I'll be making the final booking call, but per our normal process, I want to hear from each of you first -- artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration. What are your latest findings on both candidates? Let's start wherever you're ready.
